Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block
The 
technical specifications of the CB rated current 1500Amps - 400 v
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Nagy Nageb Saleh, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad general 
director, and approved by 
eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of High 
Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.
This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc
Switch off the CB and withdraw it from its cell
Switch off the DC power supply for this CB
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc
Switch off the CB and withdraw it from its cell
Switch off the DC power supply for this CB
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy tools as safety helmet, safety shoes ... 
 etc
Safety and healthy tools as safety helmet, safety shoes ... 
 etc
Cleaning materials (cloth - kerosene),
 Tool set
Work to be Carried Out
Clean it of carbon deposit and metal splashes, especially on 
 the insulating parts.
Humps on contacts surface should be removed by filing.
Examine secondary and arcing contacts, and replace them 
 when necessary.
All friction parts should be lubricated with grease.
Test the break manually several times.

المواصفات الفنية للقاطع: تيار مقنن 1500 أمبير - 400 فولت.
أعد المسودة الأولى م. Nagy Nageb Saleh، وقبلها م. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad، المدير العام، واعتمدها م. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel، رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء السد العالي، شركة Hyd.EPCo.
وثق هذه الوثيقة م. Kamel Ragheb Hakem، منسق MPIS في Hyd.EPCo.
يجب إصدار أمر شغل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة.
يلزم وجود سياج أمان (حبال) بعلامات تحذيرية يحيط بمنطقة العمل.
ارتدِ مهمات السلامة الخاصة بك مثل الخوذة والحذاء وقناع التنفس ونظارة السلامة .. إلخ.
افصل مصدر تغذية التيار المستمر الخاص بهذا القاطع.
